spec.title: Tool: z.ai GLM workers through Claude Code

p.ZAI-GLM-CLAUDE-INSTALLED: This project has installed `tool:org.vibevm.world/zai-glm-claude`. It supplies a harness-neutral operating contract for delegating bounded work to a z.ai GLM model through Claude Code, plus receipt-owned PowerShell/CMD and Bash launchers deployable under `<settings-root>/opt/bin`; the default settings root is `~/.vibe`.

installation.title: Installation state

p.LAUNCHER-LOCATION: Bare `vibe install` materialises the package and this boot contribution; it does not mutate user state. The package installation procedure then runs the explicit host deploy profile against the resolved package slot. `windows` writes exactly `<settings-root>/opt/bin/claudez.ps1` and `claudez.cmd`; `posix` writes executable `<settings-root>/opt/bin/claudez` for Linux/macOS. The default settings root is `~/.vibe`; no profile is inferred from the environment.

installation.fence: vibe deploy --profile windows --path vibevm/vibedeps/org.vibevm.world.zai-glm-claude/1.0.0 vibe deploy --profile posix --path vibevm/vibedeps/org.vibevm.world.zai-glm-claude/1.0.0

p.LAUNCHER-VERIFY: Before commissioning work, resolve the launcher from the controlled directory and run a bounded health probe. A file's presence proves installation only; the terminal probe identifies live transport and the resolved model.

p.ZAI-GLM-CLAUDE-PARENT-WORKFLOW: The parent keeps architecture, ambiguity, acceptance, integration, commits, pushes and irreversible actions. A GLM process receives a bounded packet, executes in one dedicated cwd and leaves ordinary reviewable artifacts. Its `PASS` or terminal success is evidence, never acceptance.

facts.PACKET-AS-FILE: Put substantial context in a packet file inside the worker cwd. The command-line prompt is only a short pointer repeating the authority, visible-diff and report invariants.
facts.ONE-CWD-ONE-WRITER: Give every writing worker one dedicated cwd and never run two live writers there. Parallelise only disjoint write sets; overlapping reads are harmless.
facts.REPORT-EARLY: Create the durable report skeleton after the first meaningful slice and update it before long gates. Screen prose may disappear; the report and visible artifacts are the delivery.
facts.ROOT-OWNS-ACCEPTANCE: The parent compares the report to the actual files, reads the diff/result, repeats decisive checks and issues accept, same-cwd repair, recommission or discard.

p.CODEX-PARENT: A Codex parent launches the same `claudez` command through its terminal/process runner with the worker cwd set explicitly. Native Codex subagent APIs are not a substitute for this provider-specific lane.

p.CLAUDE-PARENT: A Claude parent launches the same command from a scoped subshell or `Push-Location` block. It never leaves a persistent bare `cd` that could retarget a later continuation.

p.SAME-CWD-CONTINUATION: Fresh work uses `claudez -p`. A correction uses `claudez -c -p` only after the prior process ended and from the exact same cwd and launcher state directory. A different cwd or `CLAUDE_CONFIG_DIR` is a different conversation.

p.NO-SECRETS-TO-WORKERS: The parent may name the credential source path but never reads, hashes, copies, logs or places the token value in a packet or argv. The launcher alone reads the file and sends the bearer to the configured TLS endpoint.

p.MODEL-IS-OBSERVED: Configured aliases are requests, not proof of model identity. Record the resolved model/version from terminal metadata when available; never transfer an older GLM calibration silently to a newer alias.

p.TRANSPORT-IS-NOT-A-VERDICT: A 429, gateway error, timeout, turn cap, killed process or stalled final turn is transport state, not a verdict on surviving work. Preserve cwd, diff and report before deciding whether to continue or reroute.
